title: Te Reo Mārire i roto i te Rūma
intro: I rangona te inoi i roto i te marino o tētahi rūma tapu i ngā rā o mua, e ara ake ana i tētahi wairua kua koroheketia e hiahia ana ki ngā mea i kīia e te ao kāore e taea. Ko tēnei tangata, kua koroheketia, kua taumaha hoki i te manukanuka mō te heke mai, ka tahuri ki tō rātou Ariki me tētahi inoi whaiaro. Ko te mea i whai ake ko tētahi whakautu atua i whakahē i ngā tumanakohanga taiao katoa—he tohu ki te aroha o te Mea e whakautu ana i te karanga matekiri.
clues: I karanga ahau ki tōku Ariki i te wāhi ngaro, ka hoki atu ki tētahi rūma i whakatapua ai ahau ki te karakia ki a Ia.
I whaki ahau ki tōku Ariki i wehi ahau mō te hunga e haere mai ana i muri i ahau, i manukanuka hoki mō te arataki a tōku iwi ina wehe atu ahau.
Kua koroheke ahau—kua ngoikore ōku wheua, kua horapa hoki ngā makawe mā o tōku mahunga.
He pakoko taku hoa rangatira i tōna oranga katoa, heoi i inoi tonu ahau ki tōku Ariki kia homai he uri ki ahau i roto i tōna aroaro.
I tono ahau i tētahi tohu, ā, ka whakahoki mai tōku Ariki mā te aukati i ahau kia kaua e kōrero ki tētahi mō ngā pō e toru, i ahau e ora ana.
I whakaaria mai ki ahau he tama māku, ko Yahya tōna ingoa, he ingoa i kīia e tōku Ariki kāore anō kia hoatu ki tētahi i mua.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
